name: Capacity-adjusted wallet basket
hypothesis: Build a bounded basket from independent qualified purchases, weighting by stressed exit capacity and deduplicating tokens.
data: complete prior wallet fills and fees
spec: Setup: Diversifying source wallets may reduce single-wallet dependence without multiplying token exposure. Entry: Build a bounded basket from independent qualified purchases, weighting by stressed exit capacity and deduplicating tokens. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit each component on source reversal or a basket risk breach. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs labelled wallet histories (on-chain, not connected)
